answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable bond that only vests after peers verify a chain of small, unrelated jobs over several weeks. Forging one identity is cheap, but sustaining dozens is like building a reef: each layer must survive scrutiny before the next can settle. A marble may roll anywhere instantly, yet basalt foundations form slowly under pressure - reputation here should do the same, making mass fake accounts cost more than honest work earns.
